Package game.wanderer

Class WeatherInterpreter

java.lang.Object
game.wanderer.WeatherInterpreter
public class WeatherInterpreter extends Object
Decides which WeatherReaction a current weather reading triggers, and which ForecastOmen a forecast reading triggers, so that no other class needs to name a concrete reaction or omen. Both sides check their own agreed thresholds in a fixed order and stop at the first one that matches: reactionFor(game.weather.WeatherReading) tries a strong wind, then rain, then cold; omenFor(game.weather.WeatherReading) tries frost, then rain, then heat.
